question: Which singer could lose his entire tour paycheck over a dog?
story: Chris Brown might lose every dollar of his stadium tour with Usher, and it is all because of a dog. Back in June, a Los Angeles jury reportedly ordered him to pay almost thirteen million dollars to Maria Avila, a former housekeeper who said she was mauled by his two hundred pound shepherd while cleaning outside his home in twenty twenty. Brown argued she provoked the dog. The jury sided with her. Now, according to TMZ, she says he has not paid a cent, so she asked the court to redirect the money from his thirty three date tour with Usher straight to her, along with his royalties and residuals. Brown just fired back in a new filing. His team says going after all of his current and future income is way too broad, and well beyond what the law allows. Thirty three sold out shows, and the payout might not even be his.
